notes: Read all three units, full labor-policy context, all eight candidates and the review. Preserved praise for Republican state officials' reported completed union-law reforms as both evaluation and factual account rather than generic support. Resolved the urged officials as U.S. officials. Identified the U.S. Constitution in both unresolved claims and restored the Republican Party's explicit self-identification as its party.

claims.claim_text: The platform praises Republican governors and state legislators for reforms to public-employee-union laws that it says saved their states from fiscal disaster.
U.S. elected officials are urged to follow those state public-employee-union reforms to avoid state and local defaults and public-service collapse.
The Republican Party identifies itself as the party of the U.S. Constitution.
The U.S. Constitution is characterized as perhaps the greatest political document ever written.
The U.S. Constitution's ideals are said to have been emulated worldwide and to have brought unprecedented prosperity to billions.
